reviews.title: It’s improved
reviews.text:
I’ve been a regular Tandem user since 2016.

There are a lot of pluses and minuses, especially if you compare the current version with the original version.

In Old Tandem, you could learn eight languages at once, and switch languages as often as you wanted.

Now you can only learn one language at a time and you have to wait 24 hours to switch languages.

It’s cool because you can connect with people from all over the world. I made friendships in 2016 and 2017 that I still maintain today.

Attempting to date other Tandem users is strictly prohibited, so the quality of the atmosphere is very good.

There was a period when the app wasn’t working at all but they fixed a lot of bugs and now it works a lot better.

reviews.title: They don’t answer customer concerns.
reviews.text: Absolutely terrible customer service. I’ve emailed them various times about how I was swindled into upgrading to a non-free trial version of Pro Tandem, without any differentiation from the free trial to an actual subscription. I haven’t gotten any responses by a real person, only AI responses that don’t help at all, and only tell me I have to wait. I’ve been waiting, and this charge on my account has been blocking my ability to make purchases on my phone and download apps. It’s getting incredibly stressful day-by-day. The day that I switched my trial (without prior knowledge it was a $15 subscription), it went through without payment, further leading me to believe it was a free trial upgrade. The app didn’t tell me I had to pay at all. Then, the next night, my card was charged over 60 times, I kid you not, from Tandem for $14.99. At that moment, I was at a birthday dinner, trying to take pictures with my family, and was unable to take any more because the 60 notifications had slowed my phone down tremendously. They haven’t answered my emails, my DMs, nothing, so a bad review is my last resort. If I knew Tandem was like this I would’ve never downloaded the app, shame on you guys. I do not recommend this app to anyone that doesn’t want to be locked into a $15 subscription out of nowhere.

reviews.title: Too Many Fake Accounts!
reviews.text: I’m giving this app a 1-star rating. I joined Tandem with the intention of learning languages, hoping to connect with real native speakers and build my international network. I was initially very excited, but since yesterday, I’ve been overwhelmed by a wave of fake accounts causing constant nuisance. This is not a dating app! In just 24 hours, I came across at least 50 fake profiles. Instead of focusing on learning and meaningful practice, I feel like a detective constantly trying to figure out who is real and who isn't. The developers need to address this immediately—for instance, by strictly preventing users from faking their locations using VPNs or location spoofing. The environment here is disappointing, and I will be deleting the app.

reviews.title: Good app, but unreliable messaging
reviews.text:
So far I’ve been enjoying using this app, except for one thing: the message sending/receiving is not very reliable.

I had coordinated to do a video call with someone at a specific time. When the time came, I messaged them to ask if they were still available. Over the next 5 min, I sent another couple messages, but they weren’t responding, even though the app said they had seen my first message.

I waited another 30 minutes before sending a final message saying the I had to go to work and that we could call another day.

Only then did they respond to me, saying “okay, no worries”. I asked what happened, and they said they didn’t get my earlier messages, so they had just been sitting around waiting for me to call.

This was very frustrating and wasted both of our time. This is the only time so far in the few weeks I’ve been using this app that I’ve seen failed message delivery (at least that I’m aware of), but it is still unacceptable, especially when the app is explicitly telling me the messages were delivered when they weren’t.

Unfortunately, I had to delete the app after 15 minutes — some male profiles on the app made me extremely uncomfortable. Of course, I was also able to have some great conversations, but for me, the drawbacks outweighed the benefits of the app. I know this is not really in the developers’ control, but for that reason, I would not recommend this app to younger women.
